name: Cambridge-style A2 Key (Writing)
description: Four criteria scored 0-5 with A2 expectations, modelled on the public structure of the A2 Key writing assessment.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: All the points asked for in the task are included and the reader gets the basic information they need.

criteria.name: Communicative Achievement
criteria.description: The text is suitable for its purpose (e.g. a short email or a simple story) and communicates simple ideas clearly.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: The text is connected using basic linking words (and, but, because, then) and simple referencing.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: Uses basic everyday vocabulary and simple grammatical forms with reasonable control; errors may be noticeable but the meaning is still clear.
